decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-008152 is on card CRD-000243. It posted on 2026-09-04 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 53 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 9462 cents (94.62 EUR). Authorisation AUTH-008337 approved 8449 cents (84.49 EUR) for a contactless payment. The merchant, Meadowlark Bistro (MER-000011), is listed as a RESTAURANT. No receipt is attached, so the 84.49 EUR bill is only the cardholder's own figure. The difference is 9462 - 8449 = 1013 cents (10.13 EUR). The tip limit is 20% of the authorised amount, 0.20 x 8449 = 1689.8 cents. The difference is below that limit. Under amount-restaurant-tip, a restaurant may post up to 20% above the authorised amount for a tip, and that counts as an agreed tip rather than a mismatch.

proposed_actions.reason: Meadowlark Bistro, a restaurant, approved the payment for 84.49 EUR and charged 94.62 EUR. The extra 10.13 EUR is within the 20% allowed for a tip on restaurant payments, so under our policy it is treated as an agreed tip, not a wrong amount.
